headline: Cutting $800,000 from the Department of Public Works FY2027 budget to cover the FY2026 snow and ice deficit.
summary: Order 448-26 would reduce the Public Works budget for fiscal 2027 by $800,000. That money would instead be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report.
items: Order 448-26: reduce the Department of Public Works FY2027 appropriation by $800,000, from $9,525,480 to $8,725,480
Raise the FY2026 snow and ice deficit on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report instead of in the FY2027 budget
location: City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148

**448-26** 

Ordered: That the FY2027 General Fund appropriation order, Schedule B, for the fiscal year July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, be and hereby is amended by reducing the appropriation for the Department of Public Works by Eight Hundred Thousand Dollars ($800,000), from Nine Million Five Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($9,525,480) to Eight Million Seven Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($8,725,480). Said reduction shall eliminate the $800,000 appropriated within the Department of Public Works FY2027 budget for the FY2026 snow and ice deficit, which will instead be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report.

All other provisions of the FY2027 appropriation order shall remain unchanged.
